name: Assignment
description: Whom a row is assigned to (D104): Seats with one seat, assignee, that seats one subject at most and refuses a take while it is full, so a caller assigns an unassigned row to itself and leaves it, and a caller holding assign seats or unseats another. A Workflow transition's or a StateRules state's by names the seat as seat:assignee. D104's guard on another principal's Lease acquire, which reads the seat, waits for the declarative vocabulary's caller operand.

take.description: The permission a caller needs to assign the row to itself; any caller may when absent.

assign.description: The permission a caller needs to assign the row to another subject or unassign another; no caller may when absent.
